extras.name: Accurate
extras.summary: +2 to attack checks with the effect per rank.

extras.name: Affects Corporeal
extras.summary: Lets an incorporeal user's effect work on corporeal targets at a rank equal to extra ranks.

extras.name: Affects Insubstantial
extras.summary: Effect also works on insubstantial targets at half (1 point) or full (2 points) rank.

extras.name: Affects Objects
extras.summary: Fortitude-resisted effect also works on objects (+1), or only on objects (+0).

extras.name: Affects Others
extras.summary: Grant a personal effect to others by touch (+1), or to others only (+0).

extras.name: Alternate Effect
extras.summary: Adds an alternate setting to a power's array; Dynamic versions can share points.

extras.name: Alternate Resistance
extras.summary: Effect is resisted by a different defense: +1 if easier to beat, +0 if equivalent.

extras.name: Area
extras.summary: Effect fills an area shape instead of needing an attack; each extra +1 doubles area distance.

extras.name: Attack
extras.summary: Turns a personal effect into a close attack used on others (e.g. Teleport Attack).

extras.name: Contagious
extras.summary: Effect spreads to anyone who touches an affected target.

extras.name: Dimensional
extras.summary: Effect reaches into one dimension (1), a related group (2), or any dimension (3).

extras.name: Extended Range
extras.summary: Doubles all range increments of a ranged effect per rank.

extras.name: Feature
extras.summary: Adds a minor extra capability to the effect per rank.

extras.name: Homing
extras.summary: A missed ranged attack tries again next turn; one extra attempt per rank.

extras.name: Impervious
extras.summary: Defense ignores effects whose rank is half the Impervious rank (rounded up) or less.

extras.name: Increased Duration
extras.summary: Raises duration one step: instant to concentration, concentration to sustained, sustained to continuous.

extras.name: Increased Mass
extras.summary: Adds 1 to the mass rank an effect (e.g. Teleport) can carry per rank.

extras.name: Increased Range
extras.summary: Raises range one step: close to ranged, ranged to perception (close-to-perception is +2).

extras.name: Incurable
extras.summary: Healing and Regeneration cannot remove the effect's results (unless Persistent).

extras.name: Indirect
extras.summary: Ranged effect originates from a point other than the user, ignoring intervening cover (1-4 ranks).

extras.name: Innate
extras.summary: Effect is an inborn trait and cannot be Nullified.

extras.name: Insidious
extras.summary: Results of the effect are hard to detect (DC 20 check or unusual sense).

extras.name: Linked
extras.summary: Two or more effects always work together as one action; costs simply add up.

extras.name: Multiattack
extras.summary: Hit multiple targets, or one target several times for a higher resistance DC.

extras.name: Penetrating
extras.summary: Overcomes Impervious defenses up to the Penetrating rank (max effect rank).

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Effect can perform delicate, fine-control tasks.

extras.name: Reach
extras.summary: Extends a close effect's reach by 5 feet per rank.

extras.name: Reaction
extras.summary: Effect triggers automatically as a reaction: +1 from a free action, +3 from a standard action.

extras.name: Reversible
extras.summary: You can undo the effect's results at will as a free action.

extras.name: Ricochet
extras.summary: Bounce an attack off surfaces to change direction, one bounce per rank.

extras.name: Secondary Effect
extras.summary: Instant effect hits the target again on the following round.

extras.name: Selective
extras.summary: Choose who is and is not affected, mainly for area effects.

extras.name: Sleep
extras.summary: Effect leaves targets asleep instead of incapacitated.

extras.name: Split
extras.summary: Divide a single-target effect's ranks among an extra target per rank.

extras.name: Subtle
extras.summary: Effect is hard to notice (1 point, DC 20 Perception) or undetectable (2 points).

extras.name: Sustained
extras.summary: Turns a permanent effect into a sustained one (usable with extra effort).

extras.name: Triggered
extras.summary: Set an instant effect to go off later under chosen circumstances; one use per rank.

extras.name: Variable Descriptor
extras.summary: Change the effect's descriptors within a closely related (1) or broad (2) group.

flaws.name: Activation
flaws.summary: Power needs a move (-1) or standard (-2) action to switch on before its effects work.

flaws.name: Check Required
flaws.summary: Must pass a check (DC 10 + flaw ranks) to use the effect.

flaws.name: Concentration
flaws.summary: Sustained effect becomes concentration duration (standard action to maintain).

flaws.name: Diminished Range
flaws.summary: Shrinks the effect's short/medium/long range increments per rank (max 3).

flaws.name: Distracting
flaws.summary: You are vulnerable until your next turn after using the effect.

flaws.name: Fades
flaws.summary: Effect loses 1 rank per use until recovered.

flaws.name: Feedback
flaws.summary: You take damage when the effect's physical manifestation is damaged.

flaws.name: Grab-Based
flaws.summary: Effect only works after a successful grab.

flaws.name: Inaccurate
flaws.summary: -2 to attack checks with the effect per rank.

flaws.name: Increased Action
flaws.summary: Each step up in required action (free to move to standard...) is -1 per rank.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.summary: Effect works only in certain situations or on certain things (about half usefulness).

flaws.name: Noticeable
flaws.summary: A continuous or permanent effect has an obvious display.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: Continuous effect becomes permanent: always on, no extra effort.

flaws.name: Quirk
flaws.summary: A minor nuisance attached to the effect, the opposite of a Feature.

flaws.name: Reduced Range
flaws.summary: Lowers range one step per rank (perception to ranged to close).

flaws.name: Removable
flaws.summary: Power can be taken away: -1 per 5 points of final cost, or -2 per 5 if Easily Removable (Indestructible reduces the flaw by 1 flat).

flaws.name: Resistible
flaws.summary: Effect gains a (or an additional) resistance check of a chosen defense.

flaws.name: Sense-Dependent
flaws.summary: Target must perceive the effect with a chosen sense for it to work (Dodge to avert).

flaws.name: Side Effect
flaws.summary: Failing with the effect (-1) or using it at all (-2) causes you a problem.

flaws.name: Tiring
flaws.summary: Using the effect leaves you fatigued.

flaws.name: Uncontrolled
flaws.summary: The GM, not you, decides when and how the effect works.

flaws.name: Unreliable
flaws.summary: Effect fails on a d20 roll of 10 or less (or has only five uses).
